app.name: TimeLion
language.label: Language
home.title: Find a date together – without giving away your data
home.lead: TimeLion is a simple, open-source tool for scheduling polls. Polls are encrypted in your browser: the server never learns what they are about or who voted.
home.comingSoon: TimeLion is being rebuilt. Creating polls will be possible again soon.
home.features.title: What makes TimeLion different
home.feature.encrypted.title: End-to-end encrypted
home.feature.encrypted.text: The key lives in the link and never leaves your browser.
home.feature.noAccount.title: No account, no cookies
home.feature.noAccount.text: No sign-up, no tracking, no ads, no third parties.
home.feature.expiry.title: Deletes itself
home.feature.expiry.text: Every poll has an expiry date and is permanently deleted afterwards.
notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: This page does not exist. Check the link or go back to the start page.
error.network: The server can't be reached. Check your connection and try again.
error.rateLimited: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a while, then try again.
error.notFound: This poll doesn't exist (any more). It has expired or was deleted.
error.pollClosed: This poll is closed. Responses can no longer be changed.
error.tooManyResponses: This poll has reached the maximum number of responses.
error.tooLarge: The poll is too large. Shorten the texts or remove some dates.
error.invalidExpiry: The expiry date was not accepted. Pick an earlier date.
error.unreadable: The link is incomplete or wrong: the key in it doesn't decrypt the poll.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
